author: nicolas
summary: Liraasa 2.3 (ADR-0019), from the author's sound-pass patch: rulings 2.3:G69–G71; 13 roots respelled (lenra → zarku, vanru → dokra, voho → kezdo, vabale → tobra, teyo → dento, mege → yumli, kupa → ruko, jemla → zimzi, pesbi → bondo, menha → gamdo, vugo → vizu, salye → bapi, senba → linle); bear and cow made the roots bumbo and murmu, and frog the new root kerku (mirunululirayo retired); wolf rebuilt as farvibudi (farvi + budi), superseding the wolf half of 2.1:G59; every form, compound, image compound, derivation and example sentence built on them follows.

rulings.ruling: Thirteen roots are respelled: lenra -> zarku; vanru -> dokra; voho -> kezdo; vabale -> tobra; teyo -> dento; mege -> yumli; kupa -> ruko; jemla -> zimzi; pesbi -> bondo; menha -> gamdo; vugo -> vizu; salye -> bapi; senba -> linle. 2.1:G58 applies in full: a respelled root keeps every meaning and empty slot; all forms, derivations, compounds and image compounds respell with it; compound verbs follow the new first letter; 2.2 spellings retired; older texts, including the album, are read under the spellings they were written in.

bumbo (bear), murmu (cow; cattle) and kerku (frog) are new roots. They replace larbopagoregna, maremirulazu and the listed derivation mirunululirayo, which are retired; kerku takes the verb kerkuka, to croak. mirunululira (river-song) stays.
larbopagobudi -> farvibudi (farvi + budi), 'wild dog', read like farvilazu (wild animal); lunolarbopagobudi -> lunofarvibudi. Supersedes the wolf half of 2.1:G59; its taha -> kezupago half stands.

headwords.notes: Added in 2.3 (changeset 2026-10-19-lexicon-2-3). Replaces the listed derivation mirunululira + -yo (frog (river-singer)), which is retired (2.3:G70).
